newsitem.title: USA: Genovese says it is not in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Genovese says it is not in merger talks.

text.p: Genovese Drug Stores Inc vice president and general counsel Gene Wexler said the drug store chain is not in merger talks with any company.
"We're in no merger talks with anybody," Wexler said.

Wexler was responding to a Business Week article that quoted an analyst who said Genovese could be a buyout target. The analyst said Genovese would be a good fit with J.C. Penney Co Inc's Thrift Drug unit.
A J.C. Penney spokesman said it is not in any talks with Genovese Drug stores and it is busy combining the operations of Fay's and its Thrift Drugs unit.
"Just because an analyst thinks it's a nice idea doesn't mean that it's anywhere near reality," the spokesman said.
Genovese shares traded at 12-3/4, up 1/2, on 60,600 shares traded. The stock, which had a delayed opening, had hit a high of 13-1/4 earlier today.
